verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a hosted Trust Center with a custom domain and branding. It continuously pulls control monitoring data into the page, with admin hide/show controls. Visitors can self-serve or request sensitive security documents, and admins approve or deny requests and enforce an NDA. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit mention of certification badges and the click-through mechanics of the NDA, evidence of the effect on security-review or deal velocity.
